name: AAJ Electronics Inc.
old_description: "Tailored solutions for every business type, backed by industry-leading technology and support"
about:
AAJ Electronics Inc. is based in Smithfield, Rhode Island. Founded in 2002, the company began as an electronics sales and repair business before evolving into a full-service point-of-sale (POS) partner for retail and hospitality merchants. Ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The company provides POS systems, payment processing, and related technology services. It resells and implements several POS platforms—including PC America CRE for Windows-based retail, NRS for cloud-connected convenience stores, Genius Retail for Android-based retail, and Genius Restaurant for full-service and quick-service dining. Beyond software, AAJ Electronics offers implementation, staff training, 24/7 remote support, and ongoing system tuning. Services extend to online ordering integration, self-service kiosks, loyalty and gift-card programs, inventory management via handheld devices, lottery tracking, label and barcode printing, digital menu boards, AI-powered invoice automation, and multi-location management. The firm acts as a dealer for payment processors Global Payments, Fiserv, and TSYS.

AAJ Electronics serves retail segments such as liquor stores, convenience stores, smoke and tobacco shops, grocery and meat markets, apparel and specialty retailers, and food trucks. In hospitality, its clients include fine-dining restaurants, quick-service restaurants (QSR), pizzerias, cafés and bakeries, bars and nightlife venues, and food trucks. The company targets single-location and multi-location operators needing integrated sales, inventory, and payment workflows.

The company emphasizes matching technology to each merchant’s workflow rather than pushing a single platform, citing over 20 years of POS experience and U.S.-based onboarding and support as differentiators.
